page.overview:
Who is Stass Allie?

Stass Allie, a Force-sensitive Tholothian female, was a Jedi Master who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic. She was also the cousin of Jedi Master and Jedi High Council member Adi Gallia. Allie became a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic and gained a seat on the High Council of the Jedi Order late in the Clone Wars when Gallia was killed.

Allie would not serve on the Council long before her demise on the planet Saleucami during the waning hours of the Clone Wars. Having received the command to execute Order 66 from the Sith Lord Darth Sidious, Clone Marshal Commander Neyo and a clone trooper lieutenant opened fire on their general from their speeder bikes, killing her instantly.

Stass Allie was born on Tholoth prior to the Separatist Crisis. Allie was found to be Force-sensitive and brought to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant to start her Jedi training. She specialized in the art of healing, which would later become an invaluable resource during the long bloody years of the Clone Wars. Like her cousin, Allie would also become a consular and rising star diplomat. She was eventually granted the title of Jedi Master and became a member of the Circle of Jedi Healers, in addition to serving as an overseer of the Medical Corps.

Allie was present in Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's office along with other senators and Jedi as the issue of whether Palpatine should take emergency powers was debated.
